title: cystopteris pellucida
intro: Cystopteris pellucida, commonly known as the transparent fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. It is a deciduous, terrestrial fern that grows in shaded, humid areas and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The transparent fern is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in relieving respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cystopteris pellucida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
